listings.title: Momot
listings.body: A small gray cat with white socks, about eighteen months old, found near the Caycuma river bridge. Momot is shy but loves other cats. Needs a calm home without small children.

listings.title: Badem
listings.body: A one-eared yellow dog, around four years old. Walks beautifully on a lead and adores children. Needs a family with a garden — or at least a long daily walk and a person who has time to listen.

listings.title: Two shy kittens
listings.body: Two bonded tabby kittens (brother and sister) about ten weeks old. Must be adopted together. They are still learning to trust — perfect for a patient person who has had cats before.

listings.title: Kaşar
listings.body: A big gentle giant of a dog. Kaşar is calm, loving, and patient. He is gentle even with the smallest rescues in our care. A small farm or a quiet couple would suit him perfectly.
